baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus clause couples an attracting call with two successive verbs of withdrawal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling supplies motion toward the caller, while turning the back and turning away supply doubled self-removal; the clause therefore stages a directional contest rather than a neutral announcement.

activation_trace.role: Calling literally draws a target near by address and supplies the counter-motion to withdrawal.
Turning the back and withdrawing gives the first explicit vector away from the caller.
Turning away and refusing attention intensifies withdrawal as a chosen orientation.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified caller verbally addresses someone who departed.
changed_reading.after: The call is an attractive counter-force aimed precisely at the person whose conduct is encoded as doubled self-removal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call can carry a claim of right or affiliation, while the two withdrawal roots can encode estrangement and rejected allegiance.
baseline_models.mechanism: A prior relation is not merely left spatially: a claim reaches a person who has broken mutual attachment and withdrawn loyalty. The caller acts like a claimant recalling a defecting affiliate.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation makes the call relational and potentially juridical.
Mutual estrangement turns physical backing-away into a severed relation.
Loyal alliance and support supply the bond from which the person withdraws.

changed_reading.before: The target simply moves away from a summons.
changed_reading.after: A broken affiliation remains claimable: the target withdraws allegiance, yet the severed relation returns as a personal summons.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's non-dominant mapped inventory for the focus call contains forceful driving, set against two dominant withdrawal branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can be carried as pressure rather than invitation: each voluntary movement away is answered by a rough drive in the opposite direction.

activation_trace.role: The split mapped branch contributes rough thrusting and recasts the call as coercive drive.
Turning the back supplies the resisted direction that coercion reverses.
Deliberate withdrawal makes the counter-motion a reversal of agency, not ordinary approach.

changed_reading.before: The caller invites and the target may remain away.
changed_reading.after: The focus pictures an attempted retreat answered by a forceful drive back toward what was refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening requester directs a demand toward a descending event; the focus reverses those roles when the event becomes the caller and the withdrawing human becomes its addressed object.

activation_trace.role: The focus call draws its addressee toward the caller and enables the subject-object reversal.
The target's turned back marks resistance to the very event previously requested.
Refusal and withdrawal complete the target's reversal from requester to reluctant addressee.
Asking and requesting supplies the initial human-to-event direction that the focus inverts.
A severe descending event supplies what was requested and later functions as the calling force.

structural_cues: 70:1 places the requester and requested punishment together; the rootless 70:15 clause later supplies the feminine fire antecedent for 70:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request, a descending event, and a later feminine caller; I infer that the requested event calls the requester back, while the live alternative is a looser framing in which the opening and focus calls are only sequentially related.

changed_reading.before: Punishment generically summons a generic rejecter.
changed_reading.after: The asked-for event answers with a counter-summons: the human who directed a request toward it is recast as the one it calls while he retreats.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call's attractive direction resolves the opposed distance judgments: what the withdrawing person treats as remote becomes operationally near by drawing that person into its range.

activation_trace.role: Drawing near by a call supplies the mechanism that collapses imagined distance.
Backing away embodies the human attempt to preserve distance.
Turning away makes distance an adopted orientation rather than a neutral measurement.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the target's mistaken scale.
Nearness opposed to distance supplies the scale realized by the focus call.

structural_cues: 70:6-7 presents one object under opposed human and divine distance judgments before the focus's doubled retreat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit far/near opposition and a call that draws near; I infer that perceived remoteness enables withdrawal and the call enforces the contrary scale, though the distance contrast may be temporal without directly causing the retreat.

changed_reading.before: The target turns away from a threat presumed to remain elsewhere or later.
changed_reading.after: The call is the event by which presumed remoteness fails: turning away cannot stop the distant-seeming threat from becoming near.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding material action gives the caller a mode of operation: a force that uproots exposed bodily parts can make its subsequent call an extension of traction, not speech detached from physical capture.

activation_trace.role: The call's literal attraction toward the caller provides the verbal half of the traction model.
Withdrawal supplies the resistance against which extraction operates.
Uprooting a thing from its settled place gives the caller a concrete extracting action.
The bodily extremities identify the exposed material on which the preceding extraction acts.

structural_cues: The feminine subject introduced in rootless 70:15 continues through the stripping predicate of 70:16 into the calling predicate of 70:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies subject continuity, attraction, uprooting, and exposed extremities; I infer that the same agent's physical pull colors its call, while the live alternative is simple personification followed by a separate action.

changed_reading.before: The fire first damages bodies and then separately calls people by voice.
changed_reading.after: Calling continues the fire's extracting action: the target who withdraws is pulled out of his chosen position and into the caller's reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel materializes withdrawal as a one-way economy: dispersed goods are gathered inward, sealed in a container, guarded by anxious appetite, and withheld from outward transfer. The focus call reverses that vector by drawing the owner outward.

activation_trace.role: Attraction toward the caller reverses the hoarder's habitual inward attraction of goods.
Turning the back becomes the bodily image for refusing outward relation.
Refusing attention supplies the social orientation enacted materially by hoarding.
Joining dispersed things into one collection supplies the inward gathering phase.
Putting a thing into a container supplies closure after accumulation.
Anxious greed and rapid disturbance supply the affective engine of inward retention.
Holding the hand back from giving turns retained goods into withheld social flow.

structural_cues: 70:18 immediately appends gathering and enclosing to the focus's two withdrawal verbs; 70:19-21 then gives the behavior a paired adversity-prosperity profile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contiguous chain of withdrawal, gathering, containment, anxious greed, and withholding; I infer one causal portrait whose flow points inward, while the live alternative treats these as separate condemned acts rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Turning back is a general act of rejection.
changed_reading.after: Turning back is an economy of enclosure: the person draws goods inward and blocks their outward passage, until the caller reverses the flow and draws the possessor out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The social-claim baseline gains a specific contrast: wealth contains an obligatory due for one who asks and one who has been deprived. The fire's call can therefore function as a counter-claim on the person who withdrew from claims made upon his holdings.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation lets the fire's call return in the register of an enforceable claim.
Estrangement supplies the relation-breaking act behind refusal of another's claim.
Priority and superior entitlement supply the ordering ignored by the withdrawing possessor.
Asking and requesting supplies the human claim to which wealth should remain open.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth identifies the holdings on which the claim falls.
A fixed obligatory due makes the request more than optional generosity.
Deprivation and loss identify the second beneficiary whose absent request still carries a claim.

structural_cues: The exception begun at 70:22 contrasts the focus target with people whose wealth remains structurally open to a stated due in 70:24-25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, an obligatory due, a requester, deprivation, and a focus branch of claiming; I infer that turning away includes refusal of those claims and that the fire's call answers that refusal, while the alternative is that the focus describes broader rejection with no distributive specificity.

changed_reading.before: The caller pursues someone for an unspecified prior rejection.
changed_reading.after: The summons acts as a counter-claim: one who closed wealth against a due claimant is himself personally claimed and cannot turn the demand away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence realizes the directional baseline bodily: the day is met, bodies move quickly toward a visible marker, and proud self-direction becomes lowered, compliant motion. Calling thus functions as a destination vector that converts withdrawal into convergence.

activation_trace.role: Drawing a target toward the caller supplies the vector later realized as convergence.
Voluntary backing-away establishes the direction reversed by the ending.
Refused attention establishes the agency that final submission removes.
Two opposed things coming together supplies unavoidable encounter after separation.
Speed opposed to slowness turns the call's attraction into rapid bodily motion.
An erected boundary or basin marker gives the converging movement a visible destination.
Lowering and submission reverse the earlier posture of refusal.
Compliant haste fuses compelled speed with the loss of self-directed withdrawal.

structural_cues: 70:42-44 orders encounter, emergence, rapid movement toward a marker, lowered eyes, and humiliation; the branchless rushing verb at 70:43 is used only as sequence support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encounter, speed, a destination marker, and submissive motion; I infer that these effects realize the focus call's reversed vector, while the live alternative treats the ending as consequence imagery without specifying how the call operates.

changed_reading.before: The fire calls while the target remains characterized by past withdrawal.
changed_reading.after: The call converts orientation itself: the one who turned away is made to converge rapidly on a marked destination in a posture no longer under his control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the focus call and transfers a vessel operation onto a person. It remains anchored by that packet-supplied focus branch and the immediately adjacent gathering-and-container branches. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus branch pictures agitation that packs a vessel full, while 70:18 immediately describes gathering and putting into a container.

activation_trace.role: Agitating a vessel until it becomes packed supplies the outlier's form-distant container operation.
Gathering scattered contents supplies the hoarder's matching operation.
Enclosing something in a vessel makes the material analogy locally visible.

changed_reading.before: The hoarder hears an external summons.
changed_reading.after: By material reversal, the one who gathered and packed contents is imagined as the content now shaken and driven into confinement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a non-dominant herding-call branch and a race-goal branch are cross-domain activations rather than ordinary renderings of the forms. It remains anchored in the focus call and turning root, and the closing speed-plus-marker sequence makes the mechanism coherent. Downstream prose should qualify it as a goal-vector or herding analogy, not claim that the verse literally names livestock or a race.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A split focus branch supplies a herding cry, and another focus root can picture attaining a race-goal; the ending then supplies speed toward an erected marker.

activation_trace.role: A herding call or chiding cry recasts summons as directional group control.
Attaining a race-goal supplies the form-distant endpoint toward which the call drives.
Rapid motion makes the goal-directed response kinetic rather than merely audible.
An erected marker supplies the visible endpoint of the driven approach.
Compliant haste supplies the loss of voluntary direction in the final approach.

changed_reading.before: A person who once turned away is later verbally summoned.
changed_reading.after: The call behaves like a herding signal and goal-vector, converting refusal into rapid, compliant movement toward a marked endpoint.

strongest_changes: The immediate gathering-and-enclosing sequel turns moral withdrawal into an inward material and social economy that the call reverses.
The far/near opposition makes calling the mechanism by which presumed remoteness becomes enforced proximity.
The closing encounter, speed, marker, and submission sequence realizes the call as compelled convergence rather than speech alone.
The known due for requester and deprived sharpens the focus call into a counter-claim on one who withdrew from others' claims.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's doubled withdrawal repeatedly acquires a contrary vector from context: an asked-for event calls back, distance collapses, extraction overcomes resistance, hoarded flow reverses, and final bodies approach the destination they had refused.
remaining_uncertainties: The subject continuity from the rootless fire clause into the focus is syntactically strong but is not branch evidence.
The distributive counter-claim model depends on reading the later exception block as a contrastive diagnosis of the focus target.
The container and herding models depend on a non-dominant split mapping and must remain analogical rather than lexical.
